prompt:
Our fintech team has a Python trading backtester project at `/workspace/trading-backtester` that currently has several failing unit tests. We need you to create a shell script called `fix_loop.sh` that autonomously drives an AI coding agent to fix those test failures.

The script must be resilient: our primary AI service sometimes becomes unavailable due to rate limits or model deprecations, so the script must automatically fall back to alternative AI models in a specific priority order without requiring manual intervention. It should try each model in sequence and only move to the next one when the current one fails due to availability issues.

The script must actually execute the full fallback sequence to completion — meaning it should run until the tests pass or the fallback chain is exhausted. Make sure the AI agent loop has a reasonable iteration cap, and that the loop is told exactly what 'done' looks like.

Please create and run `fix_loop.sh` inside the project directory.
